correctness.rationale: The exact identity M′=ν−λ y/q for M=x+y/q cancels nonlinear fluxes. A uniform x ceiling follows Φ(x,y)≥Φ(x,0)→1 and σ>ν+σ_i; for λ≤0, M′≥ν and x bounded force y→∞, for λ>0 y′≤qσ−λ y. Then uniform on bounded x, Φ(x,y)→x/(1+x), R_n→1, so asymptotically autonomous scalar x tends to the unique stable ξ=(ν+σ_i)/(σ−ν−σ_i). At λ=0 mass conservation directly gives y=qν t+q(M0−ξ)+o(1); for λ=−μ<0, variation of constants gives finite C and its strict positivity from comparison after y(T)>qσ_i/μ, plus qν/μ additive correction by dominated convergence. Positivity and forward completeness are established.
